sloka: अतिमात्रमयं देशो मनोज्ञ: प्रतिभाति मा ।तापसानां निवासो ऽयं व्यक्तं स्वर्गपथो यथा ॥ २.९३.१८॥
transliteration: atimātramayaṁ deśo manojña: pratibhāti mā ।tāpasānāṁ nivāso 'yaṁ vyaktaṁ svargapatho yathā ॥ 2.93.18॥

translations.english: Being the abode of ascetics, this region looks very charming like the pathway to heaven.
